newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn bids steady, soy offers drop.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn bids steady, soy offers drop.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis bids were mostly steady on Monday while soybean offers dropped amid a sharp rally in CBOT soybean prices, dealers said.
Beans were down because "the board was up," one U.S. exporter said.
Soft red winter and hard red winter wheat values were mostly unchanged on quiet export activity, dealers said.
"We need some wheat business. We are competitive, it is just that nobody is buying," another dealer said.
On the export front, an Egyptian private buyer bought 55,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for September shipment, several U.S. exporters said.
